{{Top|leg}}
'''Plasfoam''' was a building material that was new by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was popular on desert and artic [[Planet/Legends|planets]]; the [[Dockside Cafe]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was constructed out of plasfoam blocks.
